title: Plugin manifest (plugin.json)

id.title: Plugin id
id.description: Unique on the instance, and the name of the plugin folder. Do not change it once tables use the plugin.

name.description: The name admins and GMs see.

kind.description: `system` for a game system, which a table is created with; `module` for an add-on that GMs add to any table, whatever its system (themes, overlays, panels).

coreApi.description: The core API versions the plugin works with, as a semver range such as `^1.0.0`. A server outside the range lists the plugin as unusable.

description.description: Shown on the plugin admin page.

attribution.description: Credit for the plugin's content, such as a CC-BY licence asks for. Shown on the Plugins page and with each compendium entry from its packs.

text.description: The credit, as it must read; shown as written, in every language.

url.description: A web page for the source or its licence, linked from the credit.

hasCode.description: True exactly when the plugin has a `code/` folder. Admins must acknowledge code before enabling the plugin.

locales.description: The languages in `lang/`. Each needs its `lang/<locale>.json`.

defaultLocale.description: The language whose text shows when the viewer's language lacks a key; one of `locales`. Defaults to the first of `locales`, then `en`.
defaultLocale.title: Locale

frames.description: A module's overlays and panels. Each must be exported by `code/client` under the same name; only modules with code have them.

overlays.description: Overlays over the table page, by the name `code/client` exports them under.

interactive.description: True when the overlay takes the pointer; otherwise clicks pass through it.

panels.description: Panels in the table workspace, by the name `code/client` exports them under.

title.title: Text
title.description: The panel's title: a lang key or literal text.

frames.title: Module frames

description: The plugin manifest. Every plugin has one, at the root of its folder.
